about.title: Design with intent. Code with precision.
about.p1:
ATS Studio is a digital design and development studio created by Alexandre Terras Simões in Guarda.

We work with entrepreneurs, local businesses and teams looking for more than a website — they are looking for a clear, consistent digital presence prepared to grow.
about.p2: Every project starts with a direct conversation. We define goals, structure the experience and develop fast, functional solutions that are easy to maintain.
about.p3: Small by choice. Close to the client by principle.

card.label: Studio profile
card.note: Visual strategy, UX and code brought together into a clear, fast digital presence built to grow.

process.title: How we work.
process.subtitle: Four phases. No mystery, no fluff.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: Briefing, research, goal alignment and definition of success.
steps.longDescription: Before any pixel, we stop to understand the business, the audience and what makes the brand stand out. This is the phase that turns a vague idea into a concrete plan, with measurable goals and clear direction for every decision that follows.
details: Audit of the current site, brand and presence
Definition of objectives and success metrics

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Wireframes, mood boards, identity and clickable prototypes.
steps.longDescription: We translate strategy into visual decisions — art direction, typography, a component system and prototypes you can actually click. The goal is to validate the experience before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Clean-code build, testing, performance and accessibility.
steps.longDescription: We build with Next.js, with performance and accessibility in mind from the first commit. CMS, integrations and analytics wired up, with no technical debt left behind for the client to inherit.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Deploy, training, documentation and ongoing support.
steps.longDescription: Going live is only half the work. We handle deployment, team training, documentation and stay available to iterate based on real data — not assumptions.
